title: Find the Duplicate Number
problem statement:
Given an array of integers nums containing n + 1 integers where each integer is in the range [1, n] inclusive.

There is only one repeated number in nums, return this repeated number.

You must solve the problem without modifying the array nums and using only constant extra space.
approach: Using floyd's algorithm to detect a linked list cycle by treating the array as a linked list. we use two pointer one slow i and a faster pointer j until they meet at the same point. To find the start of the cycle which is where the duplicate is we start another slow pointer k from 0 and then loop till i & k meet and return the value.
